title: Block 3 Watermill Apartments, Raheny, Co. Dublin
seoTitle: Block 3 Watermill Apartments, Raheny, Co. Dublin
description: Quiet and safe 1st floor, end of block 2-bed / bath apartment in Coastal Watermill Apartments. Next to St. Anne's Park (240 acres, walks, gardens, par-3 golf, tennis, coffee shop, farmers market) with a beautiful walk to Dollymount Strand (3km sandy beach) on Bull Island Nature Reserve. Nearby Clontarf and Raheny villages offering restaurants and shopping. 10-minute walk to Raheny DART (4 stops to City Centre), buses nearby, and the Clontarf to Howth coastal cycleway. The layout is perfectly suited for a dedicated home office setup. Private parking space. Excellent references required. 1st Nov available
